changes.comment: Add `@excom/nucleus-kit/server`: the Kit without the elements that read the device or the person, for prerendering with `@excom/nucleus-ssr`; `SERVER_EXCLUDED_TAGS` lists their tags
Improve the progressive entry for prerendered pages: hydration stays open until the packages for the Kit tags present at startup are imported, so those elements keep their prerendered content
Add the `@excom/nucleus-kit/nucleus-kit.progressive` import path: the progressive entry is exported under its plain name as well as `nucleus-kit.progressive.min`
